verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a public REST API for syncs, models, sources, and destinations. It publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 spec (36 paths) at api.hightouch.io, which renders the Redoc reference. The API guide covers base URL, bearer-token auth, rate limits, and keys scoped to a viewer role for AI tools. The 404s at hightouch.com OpenAPI paths are explained by the spec living on the API domain, so they are not a contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence that the REST API covers audiences, journeys, and other Customer Studio/AI features (these appear only via MCP), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and an interactive try-it runner.
